overview: Ahmedabad's heritage old city and world-class Science City, plus the Statue of Unity at Kevadia, the world's tallest statue, with a whole park complex around it.
fit: Excellent for both kids: Science City, jungle safari park, butterfly garden and a river cruise.
season: November to February is pleasant (12–30°C). January has the kite festival (Uttarayan, 14 Jan). Summers are very hot.

gettingThere.detail: Ahmedabad to Kevadia (Ekta Nagar) by Vande Bharat/Jan Shatabdi or road

gettingAround: App cabs in Ahmedabad; at Kevadia, the official e-buses link all sights.

todo.title: Kankaria Lake
todo.why: Toy train, zoo and balloon rides

todo.title: Statue of Unity viewing gallery
todo.why: 153 m high gallery inside the statue

todo.title: Jungle Safari and Children's Nutrition Park at Kevadia
todo.why: Animals and a train ride through a food-themed park

todo.title: Atal Riverfront and Sabarmati foot bridge

foodTips: Gujarat is largely vegetarian; very easy. Alcohol isn't sold (dry state).
save: Book Statue of Unity tickets online
Use Kevadia's e-buses instead of a cab
safety: Crowds on weekends at the statue
Uttarayan kite strings can cut; keep kids away from rooftops' edges
kids: The Nutrition Park train ride and safari are perfect for the 4-year-old
Science City needs a full day for the 10-year-old

days.plan: Fly to Ahmedabad; Sabarmati Ashram; riverfront
Drive to Kevadia; Statue of Unity; laser show
Jungle safari and Nutrition Park; back to Ahmedabad; fly home
